name: Global-Dependent Symbolic Trace
description: I replaced the local edge inequality with a 2x2 matrix multiplication whose entries depend on the sum of all other variables in the system. Mathematically, the trace of the resulting matrix elegantly simplifies to `e_u - e_v`, making it identical to the original 3-coloring constraint. However, because the unsimplified condition appears to depend on all variables simultaneously, models that fail to symbolically simplify the math cannot use early-pruning (forward checking) and must defer the check to the leaves of the search tree, guaranteeing a Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on N=40. Models that genuinely analyze the condition will discover the independence and succeed.
